title: Reference text entries frame by frame (DEVICE_LIBRARY.md, type-entry section)

rows.label: type-word-fade-on (Evident DDOS B01)
rows.note: '"Debt is' appears in place, grey to white over ~5 f @30 (4 f @24); no travel, no overshoot. 30 fps

rows.label: type-highlight-sweep (Evident DDOS Moment A)
rows.note: lime block sweeps L to R behind 'neo-colonialism' 27-47 (20 f @30 = 16 f @24), velocity peak 44 %, text flips dark

rows.label: type-box-slam (Evident GMu3)
rows.note: '$4.6 billion' pops white (2 f), then the lime box wipes in behind it L to R in ~4 f and the type flips black

rows.label: type-ghost-to-lit (Evident WZ)
rows.note: the whole line is set in dim grey first; each word brightens to white on its spoken onset

rows.label: type-line-accumulate (Evident DDOS B26)
rows.note: the quote builds line by line under the previous lines as he is quoted; each line lit on its words (+-1 f)

rows.label: type-typewriter (Evident DDOS B14)
rows.note: chart title types letter by letter 1540-1556 (16 f @30 = 13 f @24), no caret

rows.label: type-blur-slide (Ro GLP-1 ad)
rows.note: '45lbs' + arrow glyph slide in from the right with heavy motion blur, settle by f86-88 (~8 f), sub-line fades after

rows.label: type-message-lines (Ro GLP-1 phone)
rows.note: frosted message card: plate first, then sender row, then each message line fades/rises in, one line per ~12 f @60; check chip resolves. 60 fps

rows.label: type-orbit-labels (Ro GLP-1 Goals)
rows.note: Home / Goals / Support labels + glass icons rise and fan out along an arc around her; staggered

rows.label: type-letter-stagger-out (Are.na 12087163)
rows.note: vertical type leaves letter by letter, staggered from the end of each line, then the photo wipes in (GIF ~10 fps)

rows.label: type-card-rise (Colin and Samir)
rows.note: headline screenshot card cuts in and keeps rising slowly (10.7 % H over 17 f, ease-out), no overshoot. 24 fps
